findings.description: Two real editors: alice selects the question and deletes it while each editor adds a list. Stored '(empty paragraph) / - Option B / * Option A'; malformed on both pages; ask open with its pre-break row; no unselected word lost. With the real CLI, edit-ask (urgency; question; question and options) exits 1 with 'block: ask block "a1" has an empty question', which names no step. doc-edit deleting the second list by id is refused with the same text. One doc-edit inserting a question paragraph and deleting the second list is refused with the same text; adding a delete of the empty paragraph is refused with 'holds a bullet list before its question'. The message is main's (parseAskBlock, docs/ask_blocks.go:668 on main) and runs before this PR's refusal; main gives an agent the same dead end for any decision whose question a person empties. The implementer's shape test accepts it on purpose (noDeleteExplanation). Before this PR the decision was deleted; now it is kept, so an agent meets this state. Sent to the architect.
